nodes.rationale: Separate proxy and controller services need cross process auth and reconciliation before the first proxy works; orchestrating existing poolers misses the Rust protocol goal; reproducing Pgpool imports legacy constraints and a large parity burden.

nodes.label: Decision: Linux target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu over aarch64
nodes.rationale: Proxmox VE runs on 64 bit Intel and AMD hosts; GNU libc is simpler for later native code than musl.

nodes.label: Clarification 1: an array in place of a reserved capability table is a code bug; table structures take a map only (hand written Deserialize), runner up a separate check on the generic table
Clarification 2: --format=<bytes> and --config=<bytes> are unexpected argument; runner up byte level split
Clarification 3: --help=x/-h=x after check-config print help, --version/-V there are unknown option, all four =x forms first are unknown command; runner up usage error for =x
Clarification 4: nesting past the toml limit is config.syntax without location for dotted keys and headers; unbounded stays off; runner up own depth check
Clarification 5: a self-skipping cfg(unix) mode 000 test for io.permission_denied; runner up keep it untested
Clarification 6: exact column checked for one unambiguous made input with a multi-byte character, others keep at least 1; runner up exact columns everywhere
Clarification 7: FIFO with no writer recorded as a known limit; runner up refuse special files or add a read time limit (needs a thread or runtime, which AC-12 forbids)
Clarification 8: missing automatic guards for AC-12 and AC-13 become a scope 002 Follow-up; runner up shell checks in cargo test now
Clarification 9: Decision status sentence and Follow-up 1 reworded to hold in every status; runner up leave to the lead at close
